verdict.rationale: Sill's docs say it has no account and no server, and that screen and keystroke traffic travel only between your own devices. Remote use goes through your own VPN or a router port you forward, and local use runs over Wi-Fi, Direct Wireless or USB with pairing and encryption. So session traffic stays on infrastructure you run by design, with no vendor rendezvous or relay to replace. missing for 10: a self-hostable relay or rendezvous component for reaching a Mac behind NAT without a VPN or port forwarding, and independent or hands-on confirmation that no vendor server is ever in the session path.
